sourceTitle: Why the Middle Class Is Disappearing
title: The Middle Class Is Quietly Disappearing
hook: The middle class share of income, then and now.
question: Do you still count as middle class?

scenes.narration: The American middle class didn't vanish. It got squeezed, quietly, for fifty years.
In nineteen seventy-one, sixty-one percent of US adults were middle class. Today it is about half.
scenes.kicker: Share of US adults, middle class (Pew)
scenes.sub: it didn't vanish — it got squeezed

scenes.narration: And the dream is fading with it. The odds a child out-earns their parents are now close to a coin flip.
scenes.label: now a coin flip

scenes.narration: Do you still count as middle class?
